title: Scalar-pullback route in the ordinary homotopy model
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface], [new-integral-residue-derived-pull-square], [def-weil-pbc-integral-residue-tensor-pull-presentation], [new-integral-residue-tensor-model]. For prime ℓ, normed E over ℚ_ℓ, f:X→Y, a proof that ordinary integral pullback preserves flat objects, and any homotopy complex P of integral module sheaves on Y, compose the restriction/pullback comparison at reduction(QP), restriction of the inverse canonical scalar-extension pull comparison, and the canonical tensor-pull presentation on X with the target comparison of new-integral-residue-tensor-model. The result is the explicit model map of that node. This formula uses no derived tensor comparison and assumes no K-flatness of P.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: Construct the reduced functorial flat resolution of a cochain representative of Qh P. Its homotopy image R is K-flat, its ordinary pullback is K-flat by preservation of flat objects, and Qh R is isomorphic to Qh P.

Apply the component equality only to this resolving R. Regard both routes as natural transformations using Monoidal.commTensorRight, and use naturality at the constructed isomorphism Qh R ≅ Qh P. Cancel its invertible source image to obtain the route equality at Qh P.

Postcompose that equality with residueExchangeTensorModelTarget at the original P and apply integralResidue_tensorRoute_model; reassociation gives precisely residueExchangeTensorModelMap. No flatness assumption on the original P or coefficient is introduced.

proof_origin.place: Constructed simultaneous K-flat resolution, naturality descent from integralResidue_tensorGeometry_component, and the existing tensor-route model formula; decomposition with one new resolving-class obligation.

theorem integralResidue_scalarRoute_model {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hFlat : (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧.PreservesFlat)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y)) (.up ℤ)) :
    letI := residueExchangePullMonoidal ℓ E f
      (residueExchangeOrdinaryPullMonoidal ℓ E f) hFlat
    let M := DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P
    (residueExchangeRestrictPullIso ℓ E f).hom.app
          ((residueExchangeReduction ℓ E Y).obj M) ≫
        (residueExchangeRestriction ℓ E X).map
          (((residueExchangePullComparisons ℓ E).pull f).inv.app M) ≫
        (residueExchangeTensorPullIso ℓ E f).hom.app
          ((residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj M) ≫
        residueExchangeTensorModelTarget ℓ E f P =
      residueExchangeTensorModelMap ℓ E f P
